name: smwmusic-tetrisphere-phony
title: Tetrisphere - Phony
description:
This is an intense electronic DnB track from the critically-acclaimed Tetrisphere OST. It's a pretty wild departure from the usual SMW/SNES aesthetic, but it was a really fun challenge to port, and that was my main motivation.

Two versions are included, a high quality version and low quality version. More info available in the respective texts.
